genes.name: HLA Class II DR Beta 1
genes.function: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells via MHC class II
genes.ms_evidence: HLA-DRB1*15:01 allele is the strongest genetic risk factor for MS (OR 3.1). The DRB1*15:01 haplotype extends across the MHC class II region. DRB1*15:01 preferentially presents myelin peptides (MBP, PLP, MOG) to autoreactive CD4+ T cells.

genes.name: Interleukin-7 Receptor Alpha (CD127)
genes.function: Receptor for IL-7; essential for T cell survival, homeostasis, and memory T cell maintenance
genes.ms_evidence: rs6897932 SNP in IL7R exon 6 alters soluble vs membrane-bound isoform ratio (OR 1.2). Increased soluble IL-7R may enhance IL-7 bioavailability, promoting survival of autoreactive T cells.

genes.name: Interleukin-2 Receptor Alpha Chain (CD25)
genes.function: High-affinity IL-2 receptor subunit; critical for Treg development and maintenance
genes.ms_evidence: rs2104286 SNP in IL2RA associated with MS (OR 1.2). Altered IL-2 signaling impairs Treg function and lowers the activation threshold for effector T cells. Shared risk with T1D, RA, and autoimmune thyroid disease.

genes.name: CD40 (TNFRSF5)
genes.function: Costimulatory receptor on B cells and APCs; binds CD40L (CD154) on T cells to drive germinal center responses
genes.ms_evidence: CD40 rs1883832 polymorphism associated with MS (OR 1.2). Altered CD40 expression may enhance B cell-T cell interactions, promoting autoantibody production and meningeal B cell follicle formation in MS.

genes.name: CD58 (LFA-3)
genes.function: Costimulatory adhesion molecule on APCs binding CD2 on T cells; enhances T cell activation and adhesion
genes.ms_evidence: rs1335532 in CD58 associated with MS (OR 1.3). CD58-CD2 interaction is critical for T cell activation in the CNS. Reduced CD58 expression may impair Treg function.

genes.name: TNF Receptor Superfamily 1A (TNFR1)
genes.function: Primary receptor for soluble TNF-alpha; mediates pro-inflammatory signaling and apoptosis via TRADD/FADD
genes.ms_evidence: rs1800693 SNP in TNFRSF1A associated with MS (OR 1.2). Produces a soluble TNFR1 variant (Δ6-TNFR1) that may act as a decoy or dysregulate TNF signaling. Links TNF pathway to MS genetic risk.

genes.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 8
genes.function: Transcription factor regulating myeloid cell differentiation, microglial development, and type I/II IFN responses
genes.ms_evidence: IRF8 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.2). IRF8 is critical for microglial development and function. Dysregulated microglial IRF8 may contribute to CNS inflammation and demyelination.

genes.name: Cytochrome P450 Family 27 Subfamily B Member 1 (1α-Hydroxylase)
genes.function: Converts 25-hydroxyvitamin D to active 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (calcitriol); rate-limiting enzyme in vitamin D activation
genes.ms_evidence: CYP27B1 variants associated with MS (OR 1.2). Vitamin D deficiency is a well-established MS risk factor. Impaired vitamin D activation may reduce immunoregulatory effects of calcitriol on T cells and dendritic cells.

genes.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 3
genes.function: Transcription factor mediating IL-6, IL-21, IL-23 signaling; essential for Th17 differentiation
genes.ms_evidence: STAT3 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15). STAT3 is the master transcription factor for Th17 differentiation — the Th17/IL-17 axis is central to MS pathogenesis. STAT3 gain-of-function mutations cause early-onset autoimmunity.

genes.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
genes.function: JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 signaling
genes.ms_evidence: TYK2 protective variant (P1104A) reduces MS risk (OR 0.8, protective). TYK2 mediates IL-12/23-driven Th1/Th17 responses and type I IFN signaling — both implicated in MS. Deucravacitinib (TYK2 inhibitor) is in clinical development for autoimmune diseases.

genes.name: C-Type Lectin Domain Family 16 Member A
genes.function: Regulates autophagy and mitophagy; involved in antigen presentation and T cell selection in the thymus
genes.ms_evidence: rs12708716 in CLEC16A associated with MS (OR 1.15). CLEC16A is shared across multiple autoimmune diseases (MS, T1D, RA, SLE). Altered autophagy may impair thymic selection of autoreactive T cells.

genes.name: Ecotropic Viral Integration Site 5
genes.function: GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for Rab35; regulates endosomal trafficking and cell cycle progression
genes.ms_evidence: EVI5 rs11809721 associated with MS (OR 1.15). EVI5 regulates cell cycle and may influence oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and remyelination capacity.

genes.name: CD6 (T Cell Differentiation Antigen)
genes.function: Costimulatory receptor on T cells binding CD166 (ALCAM); modulates T cell activation and trafficking across the blood-brain barrier
genes.ms_evidence: rs17824933 in CD6 associated with MS (OR 1.2). CD6-ALCAM interaction mediates T cell migration across the blood-brain barrier. CD6 blockade reduces EAE severity in mouse models.

genes.name: CD86 (B7-2)
genes.function: Costimulatory ligand on APCs; binds CD28 (activation) and CTLA-4 (inhibition) on T cells
genes.ms_evidence: CD86 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15). Altered CD86 expression may shift the CD28/CTLA-4 balance, affecting T cell activation thresholds and peripheral tolerance.

genes.name: Cbl Proto-Oncogene B (E3 Ubiquitin Ligase)
genes.function: E3 ubiquitin ligase that negatively regulates TCR signaling by targeting downstream kinases for degradation; critical for peripheral T cell tolerance
genes.ms_evidence: CBLB polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15). CBLB-deficient mice develop spontaneous autoimmunity. Reduced CBLB function may impair T cell anergy and tolerance, promoting CNS autoimmunity.

genes.name: Regulator of G-Protein Signaling 1
genes.function: GTPase-activating protein that attenuates G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) signaling in B cells and T cells
genes.ms_evidence: rs1323292 in RGS1 associated with MS (OR 1.15). RGS1 regulates B cell and T cell chemotaxis. Dysregulated RGS1 expression may promote immune cell migration into the CNS.

genes.name: C-X-C Chemokine Receptor 5 (CD185)
genes.function: Chemokine receptor directing B cells and Tfh cells to lymphoid follicles via CXCL13 gradient
genes.ms_evidence: CXCR5 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15). CXCR5+ Tfh cells are enriched in MS CSF and meningeal infiltrates. CXCL13 is elevated in MS CSF and correlates with intrathecal IgG production.

genes.name: TNF Superfamily Member 14 (LIGHT / HVEM-L)
genes.function: Costimulatory ligand binding HVEM (TNFRSF14) and LTβR; promotes T cell activation, inflammation, and lymphoid neogenesis
genes.ms_evidence: TNFSF14 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.2). LIGHT-HVEM interactions promote meningeal lymphoid follicle formation (tertiary lymphoid structures) in progressive MS.

genes.name: CD226 (DNAM-1)
genes.function: Activating receptor on NK cells and CD8+ T cells; competes with inhibitory TIGIT for CD155/CD112 ligands
genes.ms_evidence: rs763361 Gly307Ser variant in CD226 associated with MS (OR 1.15). Alters CD226-TIGIT balance, potentially reducing inhibition of autoreactive CD8+ T cells in the CNS.

genes.name: Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase 1 (ERK2)
genes.function: Serine/threonine kinase in the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK pathway; regulates cell proliferation, differentiation, and survival
genes.ms_evidence: MAPK1 polymorphisms associated with MS (OR 1.15). ERK signaling is critical for oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelination. Dysregulated ERK may impair remyelination in MS lesions.

genes.name: TNF Receptor Superfamily 13B (TACI)
genes.function: Receptor for BAFF and APRIL on B cells; regulates B cell survival, class switching, and plasma cell differentiation
genes.ms_evidence: TNFRSF13B (TACI) variants associated with MS. BAFF levels are elevated in MS CSF and correlate with intrathecal IgG production. BAFF promotes survival of autoreactive B cells in the CNS.

genes.name: Interleukin-22 Receptor Subunit Alpha 2 (IL-22BP)
genes.function: Soluble decoy receptor neutralizing IL-22; regulates Th17/Th22-mediated inflammation and barrier function
genes.ms_evidence: IL22RA2 rs17066096 associated with MS (OR 1.15). IL-22 is elevated in MS lesions and may promote astrocyte proliferation and blood-brain barrier dysfunction.

genes.name: Myelin Basic Protein
genes.function: Major structural component of CNS myelin; primary autoantigen in MS
genes.ms_evidence: Prototype MS autoantigen. MBP-specific T cells in MS/EAE.

genes.name: Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein
genes.function: Myelin protein on oligodendrocyte surface; target of autoantibodies
genes.ms_evidence: Anti-MOG defines MOGAD spectrum overlapping MS.

genes.name: Interleukin-23 Receptor
genes.function: Receptor subunit for IL-23; drives Th17 cell expansion
genes.ms_evidence: IL23R R381Q protective variant (OR 0.6). Strong MS GWAS hit.

genes.name: CD4 Molecule
genes.function: Coreceptor for MHC class II; defines helper T cell lineage
genes.ms_evidence: CD4+ T cells are primary drivers of CNS inflammation in MS.

genes.name: CD8a Molecule
genes.function: Coreceptor for MHC class I; defines cytotoxic T cell lineage
genes.ms_evidence: CD8+ T cells dominate MS lesion infiltrates.

genes.name: Janus Kinase 1
genes.function: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
genes.ms_evidence: JAK1 mediates multiple MS-relevant cytokine signals.
